GUEST JOURNEY

One shared link. A phone number decides what each guest sees — there is no per-family URL and no password.

The order below is the order a guest experiences it.

THE GATED EVENT

Sangeet is the only event that hides. A guest without an invite sees no card, no menu item, and gets a 404 on the URL — enforced server-side, not by omitting the link.

The other three are open to anyone who verifies.

INFORMATION ONLY

Engagement and Haldi take no RSVP. Rather than leave the page feeling unfinished, each states plainly that there is nothing to fill in, and spends the space on what guests actually open the page for — the Haldi colour theme.'
